disclaimer: A documented checklist and evidence hints. Automated checks are not legal advice, a certification, or a guarantee of store acceptance.

policies.title: Accessible and accurate privacy policy
policies.simple: People should know what information your app collects and what happens to it.
evidence: Privacy policy URL in store metadata
Verified data collection and third-party SDK inventory

policies.title: In-app account deletion when account creation is supported
policies.simple: If someone can make an account, the app must give them a way to delete it.
evidence: Screenshots or screen recording of deletion flow

policies.title: Data safety disclosures, consent and secure handling
policies.simple: Your store answers must match what the app and its SDKs really do.

policies.title: In-app and web account deletion
policies.simple: People need a clear way to delete their app account and associated data.

policies.title: Broken access control
policies.simple: People should not be able to open or change someone else's private information.

policies.title: Software supply-chain failures
policies.simple: Check building blocks from other people before adding them to your app.
evidence: Build credentials and script permissions reviewed
